newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers up $1-$2/T on firm swaps quotes.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers up $1-$2/T on firm swaps quotes.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Monday were quoted firmer from Friday in line with higher swap indications, traders said.

Both bunker 180-cst and 380 cst were quoted around $1-$2 per tonne higher from Friday at $122-$124 and $117-$119 respectively. Traders said demand was not firm and levels were gained more support from strong paper trades.
November fuel oil was traded at $117.50/$118.50, up from Friday's $117.00-$117.75.
MDO prices were also little changed at $223-228 and gas oil at $234-$238. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
